Getting Started

Prerequisites

  • Install the command-line tools on your administrator workstation.
  • Ensure network access so the machines can download the installer and container images, or set up an isolated network with connectivity between nodes.

Prepare an image

Generate an image with the image factory using the architecture parameters for your deployment environment. For an air-gapped setup, place the images in local storage according to the chosen install method (ISO or iPXE).

Start the nodes

Boot all control plane and worker nodes from the prepared boot image. After the system boots from the ISO image you will see the management dashboard.

Note: the ISO image runs entirely in RAM and does not modify your disks until you apply the configuration.
